dedupe_keys.name: south province new caledonia historic and cultural heritage

description: Province Sud, New Caledonia publishes the historic and cultural heritage of the South Province: close to 250 monuments and items of furniture protected as historic monuments, and an inventory of about 1,800 built structures made between 2006 and 2009; the dataset holds identifier, title, description, commune, keywords, update and publication dates and coordinates. Coverage: the South Province of New Caledonia; the dataset holds a few records with coordinates and a description of the inventory, with the record last modified on 2026-09-28. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the open data portal of New Caledonia (data.gouv.nc). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licence Ouverte v2.0; cost: free. Caveats: the open data table held only 6 records when read, so it is an extract and pointer to the heritage policy, not the full inventory of 1,800 structures. Simulation uses: heritage-building exposure lists for cyclone, seismic and flood studies, and protected-asset constraints in rebuilding scenarios. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
